attBesluta.text: The details on the design is beautiful. It fit perfect on my lamps!
This are my favourite shades ever!!! They are so delicate and soft looking Highly recommended it

Soooo you have to build these yourself. How expensive are lampshades nowadays? Jeeeez. These come in three parts: the top and bottom round \"frame\" and the fabric. The fabric has little clips that attach to the metal frames, and they Velcro to connect together. They look cute, but be prepared. Lol! We used them to sit atop of some cheapy target floor lamps, instantly better!
I bought this dado blade to do half lap rough sawn lumber for a shed I was building and it worked perfect I would highly recommend this blade

Works really well. Used it to cut slots into treated 4 x 4 lumber while making a large planter. Clean cuts, no splintering. Allowed me to slide the bottom and side planks right in before securing them.
This product was shipped fast and packaged well. Works as expected. Would definitely recommend. Would like for it to have came in a wooden box but I can build one for storage purposes.
This circular saw blade set has impressed me with its solid construction and ease of use. It meets European quality expectations and feels like a product designed with real attention to detail.
